text: A variant of the sculpture's table uses two scrambled alphabets, one for the message and one for the carved letters. 0136 showed English could decide it at key lengths 8, 13 and 16. Design 2 is extended to both alphabets.
Five planted English texts per length, each against five copies that keep the carved letters at the 24 known places and shuffle the other 73; the same search on all.
Planted texts beat all their copies 5 times in 5 at 13 and 4 in 5 at 16. At 8 the search, slower with 16 checks, ran last and did not finish: no verdict.
